subject: general
question:
Refer to the following number series and answer the question that follows (all numbers are single-digit numbers only). (Counting to be done from left to right only.)

(Left) 1 2 8 4 6 9 5 8 8 7 9 2 6 6 5 8 6 3 1 1 4 4 6 (Right)

How many such even numbers are there, each of which is immediately preceded by an even number and also immediately followed by an even number?
solution:
**Given: **(Left) 1 2 8 4 6 9 5 8 8 7 9 2 6 6 5 8 6 3 1 1 4 4 6 (Right)

Now,

Even numbers, each of which is immediately preceded by an even number and also immediately followed by an even number.

So, the needed pattern is: Even — Even — Even

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c5a09a2e7932553a5d6d46b0eda425fd1a85d2c7085f307679be589fb64053ce.png] 

Thus, there are four even numbers, each of which is immediately preceded by an even number and also immediately followed by an even number.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 4**".
